rules: Same ratchet-down-only policy as the live site's tool/page-budget.json (see its 'rules' field): any PR that reduces exampleSite page weight must lower maxPageBytes (or a tightened override) in the same PR — reclaimed bytes are banked, never slack. Home has NO override — it must fit the default budget for real (Task 13 trimmed it from 137,669/138,334 B to under 135,000 B for both locales: dropped the home pricing teaser's feature-comparison rows in favour of a plans-only summary, trimmed one problems/services item each, tightened copy, and fixed a redundant home <title> duplicate). image-bearing pages below get a justified per-page override instead of a global raise.

/styleguide/.justification: Unlisted internal demo/reference page — every component in one place, including a full Figure section with a real image; not a page a template consumer ships, so a wider budget doesn't cost real visitors anything.

/products/notably/.justification: Product detail page renders a real product screenshot via the figure pipeline (AVIF/WebP/srcset) — image-bearing by design, per the ratchet policy.
